primitives.name: Deletion Aversion Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Because litigation is reasonably anticipated, Turner and its parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, and joint-venture entities (including the CTS LoneStar JV) must immediately suspend any routine or automatic deletion, overwriting, recycling, or alteration of potentially relevant information, and must preserve it in native format with all associated metadata.

primitives.breakdown_regime: Standard deletion cycles become singular events where compliance fails.
